source: Ministry of Economy & Tourism workplace questionnaire (HR).

title.ar: استبيان أنماط الشخصية في العمل (16 نمطًا)

instructions.ar: اقرأ كل عبارة واختر مدى انطباقها عليك في العمل. لا توجد إجابات صحيحة أو خاطئة، فأجب بصدق ودون تفكير طويل.
instructions.en: Read each statement and choose how well it describes you at work. There are no right or wrong answers, so answer honestly and without long thought.

items.en: I enjoy meeting new people.
I feel energized after social interactions.
I prefer discussing ideas aloud.
I often initiate conversations.
I enjoy being the center of attention.
I prefer working independently.
I need quiet time to recharge.
items.ar: أحتاج إلى وقت هادئ لاستعادة طاقتي.

items.en: I keep my thoughts to myself until they are fully formed.
I focus on possibilities more than facts.
items.ar: أركز على الاحتمالات أكثر من الحقائق.

items.en: I enjoy discussing future opportunities.
I look for patterns and connections.
I trust my intuition.
I focus on present realities.
I prefer practical solutions.
I rely on experience and proven methods.
I notice details others miss.
I make decisions based on logic.
I can separate emotions from decisions.
Fairness is more important than harmony.
I challenge ideas that do not make sense.
I consider people's feelings before decisions.
items.ar: أراعي مشاعر الناس قبل اتخاذ القرارات.

items.en: Relationships are more important than rules.
I avoid hurting others when giving feedback.
items.ar: أتجنب جرح مشاعر الآخرين عند إبداء الملاحظات.

items.en: Empathy strongly influences my decisions.
I like having a clear plan.
items.ar: أحب أن تكون لدي خطة واضحة.

items.en: I prefer schedules over spontaneity.
I complete tasks before deadlines.
I like closure and decisions.
I adapt plans as situations change.
I enjoy keeping options open.
I work best under flexibility.
items.ar: أعمل بأفضل شكل في ظروف مرنة.

items.en: I make decisions at the last moment.
